target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, disposable VirtIO disk
result: pass: guest read sectors 0 and 1 and verified the GPT header signature, invalid pointers and out-of-range requests were rejected, and zstatus reported failed=0

larger_read.result: pass: a 256-sector read crossing DMA batches reaches the last sector, verifies the backup GPT signature and preserves the guard after the destination

limits: This exposes read-only absolute sectors of the PCI VirtIO backing device, not a ZealOS drive object or a filesystem. DiskRaw, writes, installation, media removal, concurrency and transfers larger than the 256-sector test remain unverified. The Pi builds compile but do not have a supported raw PCI VirtIO boot disk through this API and were not tested on hardware.
